title: 第5章 老子外挂到了第6章 被直播鉴蛋连骗八次
slug: 御兽别人鉴定都是骗你开神兽
content_zh:
;;
陈小草算过了，一个月的时间，哪怕她天天有活干，都不可能攒够一只御兽蛋的钱。
唯一获得御兽蛋的途径，就只有再开直播。
帮助别人找到像上一次那种能开出高级御兽的蛋。
能开御兽蛋的人，都是家里有钱的主。
到时候，她就可以趁机提出要求。
一枚f级10w帝国币的蛋，肯定有人会买单的！
接下来的两天，陈小草更加努力的干活了。
谁知道什么时候才能再遇到一个上次那种‘玄学开蛋’的大佬？
她要趁现在直播被封的时候多赚点钱，等开播以后可以延长直播时长，碰碰运气。
两天时间转瞬即逝。
陈小草卡着直播封禁时间一结束就第一时间开启了直播。
直播简介也从：御兽知识讨论直播间，被她改成了：专业鉴蛋一百年直播间。
她还在修改直播设置的时候，却没有注意到，一个观众已经进入了直播间了。
-----------------
乔简这三天过的可谓是抓心挠肝的。
就在几天前，他们小队刚刚全员升到5星兽师，可以契约第二只御兽。
大家说好的用十天时间挑选御兽，然后再进副本继续升级。
如果没有陈小草的出现，他现在恐怕早就随便买一个b级御兽蛋，跟队友一起去下副本了。
可他心里实在不甘心。

陈小草信誓旦旦的话语总是会在这几天里往他脑子里钻。
他这几天一直都没有再去御兽卖场，就是在等陈小草重新开播。
他要让她帮自己选一个御兽！
可是，随着时间的流逝，明天就到了约定好下副本的时候了。
他今天无论如何也要契约御兽。
要不然，为了一个不确定的主播，而抛弃掉早已配合熟稔的队伍，乔简还没那么失智。
乔简手里死死攥着手机，在御兽卖场里走了一圈又一圈。
从早上逛到了下午，几乎每一个摊位前都停留过一段时间。
可他依旧没有下定决心买哪个御兽蛋。
可能就连乔简自己都不知道，在他心里，他依旧在等着陈小草的直播间开启提醒。
“哟？这不是曙光小队的乔简吗？”
正蹲在一个御兽摊位前挑选御兽蛋的乔简，被身后一道有些厌恶的声音打断了思绪。
content_en:
;;
Chen Xiaocao calculated that in a month, even if she had to work every day, she would not be able to save enough money for a beast egg.
The only way to obtain the Beast Taming Egg is to start a live broadcast again.
Help others find eggs that can produce high-level beasts like last time.
Those who can open beast-controlling eggs are the rich owners of their families.
When the time comes, she can take the opportunity to make her request.
Someone will definitely pay for an F-grade 100,000 empire coin egg!
In the next two days, Chen Xiaocao worked harder.
Who knows when we will meet another big boss like last time who was so 'metaphysical and open-minded'?
She wants to make more money while the live broadcast is blocked now, and when it starts, she can extend the live broadcast time and try her luck.
Two days passed in a blink of an eye.
Chen Xiaocao immediately started the live broadcast as soon as the live broadcast ban period ended.
The introduction of the live broadcast was also changed from: live broadcast room for discussion of animal control knowledge to: live broadcast room for professional egg appraisal for a hundred years.
While she was still modifying the live broadcast settings, she didn't notice that a viewer had entered the live broadcast room.
------------------
Qiao Jian's past three days were heart-wrenching.
Just a few days ago, all members of their team had been promoted to 5-star beast masters and could contract a second beast master.
Everyone agreed to use ten days to select the beast, and then enter the dungeon to continue upgrading.
If Chen Xiaocao hadn't appeared, he would have just bought a B-level beast egg and went to download the dungeon with his teammates.
But he was really unwilling to do so.
Chen Xiaocao's vowed words always entered his mind in the past few days.
He hasn't been to the Beast Control Store in the past few days, just waiting for Chen Xiaocao to start broadcasting again.
He wants her to help him choose a beast to control!
However, as time goes by, it will be time to make an appointment to download a copy tomorrow.
He had to make a contract to control the beast today no matter what.
Otherwise, Qiao Jian would not be so crazy if she abandoned the team that she was already familiar with for an uncertain anchor.
Qiao Jian clutched her cell phone tightly in her hand and walked around and around the Yushou store.
From morning to afternoon, I spent some time in front of almost every stall.
But he still hadn't made up his mind which beast-taming egg to buy.
Maybe even Qiao Jian himself didn't know that, in his heart, he was still waiting for the reminder to open Chen Xiaocao's live broadcast room.
"Yo? Isn't this Qiao Jian from the Dawn Team?"
Qiao Jian, who was squatting in front of a beast-taming stall and selecting beast-taming eggs, was interrupted from her thoughts by a somewhat disgusted voice behind her.
